verdict.rationale: First-party docs show modular building blocks: declarative components with scoped CSS, plus `.svelte.js`/`.svelte.ts` modules for reusable reactive logic and shared state. The dependency-injection half rests only on a community report praising Svelte's Context system for sharing state, with no first-party documentation of the mechanism. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the context/DI API (e.g. providing and consuming dependencies through the component tree), detail on scoping or overriding injected dependencies, and independent corroboration beyond one community comment.
